title: auxo-design.json
description: Per-app Amp design-language manifest. Everything in Amp resolves mechanically from this file — agents apply Amp by lookup, never judgment.

dial.description: Playfulness dial 0–3: selects copy register, motion overshoot, celebration rung, SA-ism/emoji permission.

archetype.description: A = dashboard, B = focused tool, C = desktop. Selects the onboarding preset.

soberZones.description: Route/path prefixes pinned to dial 0 regardless of app dial (consent, destructive, legal). Use [] for none.

brandNamespace.description: The app's brand namespace, e.g. 'memeza' or 'lethadocs'.

moments.description: Opt in to <Milestone>→scoreboard reporting. Optional; default true. Privacy-first apps (e.g. lalela) set false to hard-disable moment reporting regardless of the NEXT_PUBLIC_MOMENTS_* env. (pending-Oz — Wave 8 scoreboard policy default.)

sound.description: Force the Amp Audio default on/off, overriding the dial-derived default (dial 3 = on-whisper, dial ≤2 = off/opt-in). Optional; still user-overridable via the Settings toggle (localStorage amp:sound). Sound is only ever produced at dial ≥2 and never in a soberZone. (pending-Oz — Wave 10 audio-spec default.)
